plan_owner_impacts.impact: Notifications & Sounds canon (F3-460/461): the destinations board + event routing matrix pattern, the canonical location General > Notifications & Sounds, and the title-bar stack as the sole in-app notification affordance need to be written into the notifications canon. The routing matrix's per-cell vocabulary (always / when-unfocused / failures-only / never) plus per-event sound mapping should become the canonical routing model.

Theme canon (F3-425/444): custom TOML themes with base-theme inheritance, schema-versioned validation (theme schema 1.2 in this demo), live reload, invalid-theme diagnosis with line-level errors, fallback-to-base semantics, restart markers for font substitutions, and the live hover/focus preview interaction all need canon entries. The eight built-in ids stay the palette source of truth.

The Media routes console stays in this concept as a beyond-assignment extra. Native-vs-PM-transformation identity, fallback routes, and per-purpose history rendered here should reconcile with the media plan's capability routing tables.

New rows exercised here that need inventory entries (census note: inventory positions 817-826 are the packet's provisional block): notification destination configs (per-kind), routing matrix rows, sound library + pack registry, quiet hours, TOML theme rows, tray rows (general.desktop.minimize-to-tray / close-to-tray exist in the packet extension; destination/routing/sound/pack/theme-file rows are NEW and have no inventory ids yet).

Destination configs are typed per kind with secret fields as vault references only; routing rows are a matrix type (event x destination -> enum), not scalar rows; sound assets carry provenance (source, license, version, duration, hash, defaultFor); theme files are file-backed resources with validation state. None of these fit the current scalar row schema and need first-class resource types.

Capability chips (Fast, effort levels) render only from catalog + evidence, never inferred from names; the Haiku fastNote is the canonical counter-example. Requested vs effective route inspection on role-batch-reviewer uses PMProvider.resolveRoute and should match the models-system routing tables.

Account cards keep nickname/identity/authOwner/isolation/priority/useNext/sticky; the auth boundary chip (PMProvider.resolveAuthBoundary) makes CLI-owned vs PM-direct vs api-key vs server visible at the provider header. No simultaneous-profile pretense is added.

Installations sub-console: humanized card + advanced resolution drawer; ownership confidence gates every manage action (unknown/ambiguous is manual-only); update lifecycle strings come from PMProvider.UPDATE_STATES; verification is the seven-point checklist, never installer exit code; copilot's verification-failed -> rolled-back history is the canonical failure narrative; cursor-cli's explicit official-source offer with exact host choice and install-not-sign-in demonstrates the acquisition policy.

The OpenCode card renders serverInfo (url, version, reachability, last handshake) with a server-supplied catalog and a scoped vault token reference; the server owns provider credentials. Offline scenario flips reachability honestly.

Ten new traces land in candidate-wiring-delta.json (destinations add/test, routing set, sound upload, pack import, theme import/preview/apply, tray set, dictionary add, teacher handoff). All are concept-local state and must not be mistaken for production wiring.

Built-in sound assets and bundled themes ship with license + version + hash metadata ('PM bundled'); imported packs must never be bundled while license-unverified. The release pipeline owns asset provenance stamping.

settings_schema_impacts: Vault-reference secret type: fields matching *Ref render as reference selectors (choose existing / create in vault); reveal/copy never offered; import/export must exclude them.

Field-level validation errors: the webhook successPredicate typo ('staus') renders pinned under its field in both the card summary and the editor, and clears live when corrected - row-level error mush is not acceptable for multi-field resources.
Matrix setting type: event routing needs a first-class matrix representation with per-cell enum + per-row sound mapping.
File-backed resource state: themes carry {state: active|invalid|restart-required, errors[{line,key,message}], fallback{active,to,reason}} - the schema needs a diagnosable file resource shape.
Restart markers: uiScale.pendingRestart and theme font substitutions share one restart-banner projection; the schema should let any row or resource contribute to a single pending-restart set.

schema_event_storage_impacts: Staged 'op' events ({name, ref, phase}) project truthful ObservableWork phases for dest-test, sound-upload, pack-import, theme-reload, and the installation lifecycle; phases are state changes and are never skipped under reduced motion.
dest-test receipts persist a lastTest {when, ok, receiptId, masked:true} on the destination; the receipt id is the storage anchor.
Sound preview deliberately emits NO receipt (local-only); this asymmetry is a storage-level contract, not a UI choice.

schema_event_storage_impacts.impact: Demo op events aligned to the ObservableWork contract: progressKind (determinate|indeterminate), progress source (measured|derived|unknown), completed/total emitted only when a real denominator exists (bare percentages are stripped at the emitter), waitReason from the register's waiting_* vocabulary where applicable (e.g. waiting_resource on rate-limited test sends, waiting_for_idle surfaced through installation update states). Production schema should adopt the full state grammar: accepted..recovery_required.

migration_supersession_impacts: Supersede the old Settings chip/bloom/no-sidebar contract (cmd.settings.bloom.open retires or aliases to cmd.settings.open).
Supersede stale right-side-panel language: the Activity Bar controls one adjacent LEFT side-panel slot; the Desktop console's Activity Bar board uses that canon.

Notification surface consolidation: retire any permanent bottom-right toast stack, status-bar bell, Activity Bar notification shortcut, and dedicated Notifications side panel. The title-bar stack/count/sprout inbox is the sole in-app affordance; c2's console carries the surfaceRule copy and routes dest-test results into that stack only.

Supersede any legacy 'regular/yolo' access-mode coupling in copy; access modes are Full Access / Auto / Auto accept edits / Ask for approval (the shared demo data still carries one banned-word sentence; c2 sanitizes at render time - recorded as a data defect, fix belongs in the shared data).

Fabricated percentages in progress displays (register sections 11 and 16.6): the index-rebuild fixture previously emitted invented pct values; it now emits an honest indeterminate scanning phase followed by measured file counts.
Startup discovery scans implied by copy (register section 13): the skills-discovery row description no longer claims a startup scan; discovery is bounded and demand-driven.
slint_port_impacts: Minimap: the proportional block track + draggable viewport window maps to a custom slider driven by the scrollspy registry model (offsets from the section model, never widget geometry); keyboard parity is already role=slider.

Hover-preview theme swap: pointer-enter/exit and focus/blur bind a preview override onto the theme property; restore-on-exit must be state-driven so a rebuild mid-preview restores correctly (this build restores on every rebuild).

Routing matrix: a model-backed TableView with sticky first column and horizontal scrolling inside the container; cells are ComboBox items bound per (event, destination) - virtualize columns if destinations grow.
Palette overlay: a modal dialog layer with roving listbox focus; result kinds are data, including cross-concept receipt rows that navigate to another page (in Slint, another window/route).
Theme swatches: cards render the target theme's real tokens via scoped data-theme attributes; in Slint, feed the swatch a palette struct per theme instead of re-styling.
Only the shared shell's single allowed backdrop-filter layer is used; the new consoles add none.
